title: Shifted Fourier coefficient identity
statement: For each natural number $q$, let $d$ be the dimension chosen for the corresponding Gaussian-threshold upper-tail set, and let $F$ be the Boolean function on the $(d+1)$-dimensional sign cube that equals $1$ when the tail coordinates lie in that set and otherwise equals the first coordinate. For every coordinate $i<d$, the Fourier coefficient of the real-valued function associated to $F$ at the singleton frequency containing coordinate $i+1$ equals the Fourier coefficient of the set's indicator at the singleton frequency containing coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(d)$, where $d$ is the chosen tail dimension for $q$
